fact: Guinea-Bissau's Council of Ministers, chaired by Prime Minister Rui Duarte Barros, approved the draft decree on the National Data Governance and Protection Policy, reported by the state news agency ANG; the article has no in-body date and its published date, 2025-07-10, is a proxy for the Thursday meeting.
